text:
Olivia: Quick sync — we need to pick sequencing for the new routing/cost-controls feature. Sales says console guardrails are table-stakes for enterprise demos; eng prefers API-first with SDK samples. Can we do a fast RICE pass + concrete launch criteria?
Sam: API-first is faster to ship and easier to test. Suggest minimal API + SDK examples. RICE rough: reach=med, impact=high, confidence=med. Console effort >> API effort.
Tess: For top-5 prospects console is a blocker. If we can demo a small UI for policy toggles they likely convert. Enterprise impact is very high.
Nate: Middle ground idea — build an "admin-lite" UI that uses the same API surface. Much cheaper than full console. We can canary it to Dedicated customers. Rollout criteria: API stable, telemetry in place, 2-customer canary.
Olivia: Proposal: do API-first + admin-lite canary. Launch acceptance: SLOs met (p95 latency), audit logs + RBAC, docs + quickstart, canary with 2 customers, and a rollback plan. If RICE favors console by a large margin we'll revisit.
Sam: Ballpark effort estimates: API endpoints (2d), SDK/docs (1d), admin-lite UI (5d), e2e + audit/RBAC (3d). I'll validate. Example API call for toggles: `POST /v1/policies {"route":"/generate","limit":100000,"policy":"cost-aware"}`
Tess: :thumbsup: I can line up 2 canary customers if we hit audit + RBAC requirements. I'll channel intros.
DevEx-Bot: Reminder: add Quickstart snippet for policy toggles and a doc link to /docs/policies. Also consider adding a small sample app to the repo.
Olivia: Next steps: Sam — quick RICE calc + spec PR by EOD; Tess — list canary customers; Nate — draft RBAC/audit acceptance criteria. We'll reconvene after those items.
Sam: On it, will post numbers and a lightweight spec in this thread by 5pm.
